scope: Frozen expanded five-voice synthetic development speaker-to-panel bracket. Whole-app wake/rearm measurement; no replacement acceptance.
limits: Reused synthetic voices/phrases, approximately0.5m last user-confirmed quiet placement; no independent human/fresh/distance/noise acceptance.
Hi ESP retains AEC/AGC, while experimental Hey Nyx reads raw microphone from the same producer: whole-app comparison, not identical classifier input.
Short ordinary-negative clips do not estimate continuous false events/hour; difficult near-word populations and long conversation remain separate.
Latency bounds include afplay launch, approximate keyword annotation and HTTP polling, not sample-exact detector latency.
Wake calls are stopped immediately; source playback may end at detection. No complete first-request/reply/quiet or long-call/AEC acceptance.
Failed Hi ESP controls and bracket changes are retained. No thresholds, levels, waveform speed or weights are fitted from this measurement.
